title: Chainsaw Man’s Upcoming Live-Action Adaptation Makes Earth-Shattering Change
content: Chainsaw Man The Movie: The Reze Arc was one of the biggest anime films of 2025, and for good reason. The tragic tale of Denji and Reze’s forbidden romance saw Studio MAPPA firing on all cylinders, proving what works so well about the bloody shonen franchise.

title: A Sharknado/Anime Crossover is Coming
content: One of the wildest concepts in movie history was Sharknado , an original SyFy movie that featured the aquatic predators sucked up by a tornado and hurled at unsuspecting victims. First arriving as a made-for-TV movie in 2013, the unbelievable outing would go on to receive five sequels in total before ending in 2018.
